d:
Donald Trump backed three Republican candidates in the US midterm elections, but all three suffered defeats, according to the results described in this report. In Texas, Democrat James Talarico defeated Ken Paxton. In Ohio, Indian-origin candidate Vivek Ramaswamy lost to Democrat Amy Acton, while in South Carolina, Democrat Annie Andrews defeated Trump-backed Darlene Graham. The results raise questions about the limits of Trump's influence in state-level elections. Does a Trump endorsement still guarantee Republican candidates an electoral advantage?
